title: 调查发现超六成受访中小学生用过AI (China Youth Daily, 8,563-student survey)
notes: China Youth Daily (state media), original survey report by China Youth and Children Research Center. Supports: 8563 valid questionnaires (Jun-Aug 2025, 7 provinces), >60% used AI (18.3% regularly), 71.0% homework assistance, 20.5% want to rely on AI to think (rural 22.8% vs urban 17.7%), 47.4% privacy worry.
